FETCHED AND DIFFED, nothing to merge — upstream has not re-run since 2026-09-01, so this is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED and not our fetch failing. Two plain curl calls, no headers, no proxy, no auth: https://data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json HTTP 200, 304 bytes, snapshotDate 2026-09-01 (completedAt 2026-09-01T22:25:20Z); https://data.wowmeta.com/rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 161,730 bytes with Last-Modified: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 22:23:28 GMT. The manifest date and the rankings file's own Last-Modified AGREE, which is exactly what distinguishes a genuine upstream freeze from the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape where the rankings file had moved underneath a stale manifest — so the payload was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest. 44 blocks; selected by WHITELIST categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField === "lowerBound" + keyRange === undefined (never a mere 'not dungeon' blacklist, since melee/ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) -> 6 tank + 27 dps + 7 hps = 40 rows. All 40 lowerBound values are identical to stored at the stored 1-decimal precision and every numberOfCharacters is unchanged, so nothing was merged and the coverage date correctly does not move. wowmeta.com HTML was never fetched (stale S3 prerender) and its letters were not ingested (Ckmeans clusters of a player-count toggle). Coverage date 2026-09-01 is 5 days old, so success is not claimable; maxAgeDays 8 was NOT touched. Registry snapshots for wowmeta left unchanged because the registered pages are the HTML ones this recipe forbids fetching.

A GENUINELY FRESH REPORT — the first re-sim in several nights, and all 23 rows moved. MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1,364,686 bytes, and it HAS a 'DPS Ranking:' block (line 58), so the .html fallback was not needed and the in-progress generation log elsewhere in the file is not the report; MID1_Raid was not consulted (272-byte stub carrying the same build header, not a fallback). Era-verified off the report's own header build string rather than the visible Highcharts version: 'SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69587 Live (hotfix 2026-09-04/69587, git build HEAD ce0f19435e, no-networking)'. The HEAD hash MOVED, aa9de89aac -> ce0f19435e, which is the honest explanation for a moving parse. DATE BASIS: the header's 'hotfix 2026-09-04' is the GAME build, not the report's publication date — the file's own Last-Modified is 'Sun, 06 Sep 2026 07:27:29 GMT', i.e. regenerated this morning — so asOf is 2026-09-06; stamping the hotfix date would have REGRESSED all 23 rows by two days. The ranking block was bounded to its 44 contiguous lines = the Raid aggregate (skipped) + 43 profiles, mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed so MID2_Death_Knight_Frost and MID2_Demon_Hunter_Devourer_Void-Scarred both resolve, best hero-variant per spec -> 23 of 27 DPS specs; the 7 unmapped names are all tank profiles (Protection Warrior, Brewmaster, Protection Paladin x2, Vengeance, Blood x2), correctly excluded. All 23 values moved and every move is under 1.3% (largest Unholy DK 239,944 -> 236,833 = -1.3%; most under 0.1%) — ordinary iteration noise on a re-sim, three orders of magnitude inside maxValueMovePct 0.6, and stored precision (integer) was matched so no phantom movement was written. The four absent specs are the same Balance / Feral / Augmentation / Devastation set as bloodmallet; Augmentation is absent by design.
